digest.component_or_area: store git operations and locking (_store/gitutil, _store/lock, _commands/compact/delete/fsck, metrics/blame, metrics/git_metrics)
propositions: Rebar's many concurrent local agent processes contend on shared git lock files (.git/index.lock, ref locks) with no retry/backoff policy, causing transient failures to surface as errors instead of being absorbed automatically.

Local git call sites are unbounded or underbound against contention, leaving rebar processes stalled indefinitely on stuck locks while holding the store write lock, which cascades into fleet-wide stalls of every other agent.

Transient git lock conflicts (index.lock, ref locks briefly held by a peer) must resolve silently with automatic bounded jittered retry/backoff, routing through a single seam (_with_index_lock_retry) so all call sites inherit the policy without per-site changes.
A genuinely stuck lock (bounded timeout exhausted) surfaces exactly one actionable error naming the lock file and providing holder guidance, so operators can unblock stalled stores without guesswork.
